title: Pessoa engenheira de dados - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas. O que estamos procurando:
Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações O que oferecemos:
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso " Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Business developer & parcerias estratégicas
description:
Venha fazer parte da Velana
Estamos em busca de um(a) Business Developer & Parcerias com perfil estratégico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.
Essa posição envolve desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas com integradores, sistemas e empresas pertencentes ao ecossistema do nosso ICP como um todo, com intuito de gerar receita e também envolve a prospecção ativa de leads estratégicos, contribuindo diretamente para a expansão da Velana no ecossistema de pagamentos digitais. Buscamos alguém que já tenha vivência com o mundo de pagamentos e adquirência, seja proativo e consiga identificar oportunidades de alto valor tanto em parcerias quanto em contas potenciais.

A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras, eficientes e escaláveis.
Nossa expansão acontece através de tecnologia, estratégia comercial e desenvolvimento de parcerias relevantes dentro do ecossistema de pagamentos digitais.
Principais Responsabilidades
Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio e parcerias estratégicas;
Realizar prospecção ativa (outbound) de leads qualificados;
Desenvolver e estruturar parcerias comerciais e canais de aquisição;
Atuar de forma consultiva apresentando soluções de gateway de pagamento e processamento financeiro;
Analisar mercado, concorrência e tendências dentro do setor de pagamentos digitais e fintechs;
Gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time comercial;
Registrar e acompanhar oportunidades no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com Vendas, Produto e Marketing para fortalecer a estratégia de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência em Business Development, Parcerias e Prospecção Comercial (outbound);
Experiência com gateways de pagamento, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
Comunicação clara e habilidade de relacionamento com decisores (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a oportunidades;
Organização, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma. Diferenciais
Experiência prévia atuando em gateways de pagamento, subadquirentes ou adquirentes;
Networking dentro do ecossistema de plataformas, produtores digitais e e-commerces;
Conhecimento em integrações de pagamento, APIs ou soluções financeiras digitais. O que oferecemos
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para crescimento;
Contato direto com a liderança e participação ativa na expansão da empresa;
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional dentro de um mercado em forte crescimento;
Cultura voltada para resultado, colaboração e construção de longo prazo. Por que a Velana?
A Velana está em um momento estratégico de expansão, construindo um ecossistema sólido dentro do mercado de pagamentos digitais. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de participar ativamente da construção de novas parcerias, abertura de mercados e crescimento da empresa.
Buscamos pessoas que queiram construir junto, assumir protagonismo e fazer parte de um projeto em crescimento acelerado dentro do universo fintech.

title: Legal assistant
description:

Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred

We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. title: Human resources assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions
Do you live in BRAZIL and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
Can you type both fast and accurately?
Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income?
Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?
Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!
About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.
Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:
Compensation:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.
The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:
· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a " CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.
Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office
Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.
Minimum Education/Experience Requirements
Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement).
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred. GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application
Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.
STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :
· Your current/updated resume in English.

You must provide all the requested information and complete all the steps listed above for your application to be complete.

Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week

title: Salesforce software engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.
We're hiring across both UI/Frontend and Backend/Platform specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.
What You'll Work On
Frontend / UI Engineers will focus on:
Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows Backend / Platform Engineers will focus on:
Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
Building and supporting Mule Soft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations All engineers will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline— we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) site development
Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) in production
Experience with Mule Soft (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, Cloud Hub)
Familiarity with Platform Events and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex patterns for high-volume data processing
Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
Experience with Bootstrap or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

title: Líder técnico
description:
Estamos contratando: Tech Lead (foco Frontend)
Se você é o tipo de profissional que não só escreve código — mas eleva o time inteiro a um novo nível — essa vaga é pra você.
Sobre a vaga
Somos uma empresa Saa S em crescimento, com produtos digitais rodando em produção. Temos um time de frontend que precisa de direção técnica real: alguém que faça code review com profundidade, defina padrões, garanta qualidade e ainda contribua com código quando necessário.

→ Perfil hands-on: lidera e ainda contribui com código

100% Remoto

As inscrições são feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso processo seletivo online, onde você responde perguntas técnicas e comportamentais e já recebe na hora um parecer sobre sua compatibilidade com a vaga.

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.

Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.

VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass

Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills :
Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management.
JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language.
REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required.
Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer | Data Science
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
  • Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
  • Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
  • Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
  • Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
  • Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
  • Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policiesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor riskindicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Research Engineer, Rl Environments
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, RL Environmentsto help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.What You'll Do: 1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria. Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals. Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming. Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions. Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring. Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities. Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift. When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure. Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.2. Highly valued experience Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods. Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems. Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis. Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints. Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: Líder de Hotelaria - Hospital Vera Cruz
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a acreditação da JCI. Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região, com a inauguração de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Além disso, realizamos a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care, que em 2017, ao unir pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, iniciou a trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, com o objetivo de promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos. A atuação da empresa está voltada a cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, em três estados: São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis, com o objetivo de tornar-se a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Seguir as normas de cada setor, instituídas pelos gestores das áreas, a fim de manter o padrão dos processos, cumprindo o Código de Ética Institucional;
  • Definir prioridades, propor alternativas e ações de melhorias dos processos, visando a obtenção de melhores resultados e a readequação ou implantação de novos processos em tempo hábil, para evitar prejuízos qualitativos e financeiros à Instituição; discutir com o gestor do setor a necessidade de alteração ou implantação de novos processos antes de colocá-los em prática;
  • Acompanhar e orientar os colaboradores dos serviços de operações em relação aos trabalhos executados, fornecendo instruções para a organização e operação das rotinas e processos, bem como providenciar condições e recursos necessários, incentivando a equipe a alcançar a excelência na execução do trabalho;
  • Prestar atendimento de apoio à Enfermagem e Gerenciamento de Leito, acompanhando pedidos e reclamações de clientes internos e externos para evitar insatisfações;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores e o sistema Quality 24 (solicitação, concierge e Giro de leitos) referentes aos Serviços de Hotelaria, mantendo-os atualizados conforme necessidade dos setores;
  • Acompanhar índices de absenteísmo e turnover das áreas de apoio (Higiene, Rouparia e Segurança) e realizar análises para gerar intervenções quando necessário;
  • Realizar solicitações de ordem de serviço para manutenção, engenharia clínica, TI através do sistema informatizado e comunicar os gestores responsáveis pelos setores para acompanhar as pendências;
  • Controlar e organizar documentos pertinentes ao seu setor, visando a organização e estruturação da área;
  • Elaborar documentos informativos, explicativos e normativos para esclarecer dúvidas sobre qualquer processo interno e comunicar a necessidade de aprovação antes de divulgar;
  • Auxiliar os gestores dos setores de apoio na revisão do Manual de Normas e Rotinas semestralmente ou sempre que necessário, para mantê-los atualizados e corrigir falhas com treinamentos;
  • Desenvolver treinamentos e aplicá-los aos colaboradores dos setores de Hotelaria, sinalizando a necessidade de treinamentos a serem validados pelo gestor do setor;
  • Preencher e avaliar Registro de Ocorrência dos Serviços de Operações e participar do plano de ação para resolução de problemas;

Job description

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

description:
Overview

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 2,300 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

The Matthews Group is a 18 person group within Marex, started by Craig Matthews 35+ years ago. We have a very strong name in the agriculture brokerage space all around the world, and service clients across most all jurisdictions.

We are looking for a bright, hardworking onboarding professional who wants to work in a broad capacity across all onboarding, reporting and accounting operations for the Matthews Group division of Marex.

Responsibilities

  • Onboarding – Handle customer intake and keep brokers up to date with paperwork developments
  • Reporting Functions – Create and Generate reports tracking revenues and customer activity.
  • Accounting Operations – Overseeing all TMG bookkeeping operations, including accounts payable + accounts receivable, Monthly PnL
  • Data Management – Make sure financial data we get is well kept and organized
  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the SEC, FINRA, NFA, CFTC and other applicable exchanges.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
  • At all times complying with Marex’s Code of Conduct
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
  • To escalate risk events immediately
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills and Experience

  • 2-10 years’ experience* of working within Onboarding/KYC/AML.
  • Experience of working within a sales environment with ambitions to expand their skillset into reporting, accounting operations and a more client focused role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.
  • Hum ble, friendly, and a team player
  • Strong accounting and financial knowledge
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Communication and interpersonal skills
  • Computer proficiency
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness

Conduct Rules

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.

Collaborative – We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.

Developing our People – Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble – Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non-bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

description:
